913. Add `profile_graphview_dense_csr_receipt_v1`; dense map, reverse map, out/in offsets, out/in targets, weights, node count, and edge count should be explicit byte-accounted fields.
914. Add `profile_algorithm_hotloop_scope_caveat_v1`; hot-loop benchmarks that bypass the product graph store should be useful but visibly separated from API-compatible procedure benchmarks.
915. Add `profile_exact_ldbc_parameter_receipt_v1`; PageRank iteration count, damping, tolerance, dangling redistribution, BFS source, SSSP source, direction, and CDLP max iterations should be captured.
916. Add `profile_cpu_gpu_fallback_guard_v1`; GPU acceleration claims need eligibility criteria, feature flag, hardware availability, unsupported semantic cases, fallback reason, and CPU oracle status.
917. Add `profile_late_materialization_receipt_v1`; query execution should count NodeRef/EdgeRef rows, full materializations, lazy property resolutions, and clone avoidance.
918. Add `profile_columnar_property_store_receipt_v1`; property storage claims should record column key, type, density, sparse/dense mode, fallback map count, and read/write clone behavior.
919. Add `profile_complex_property_fallback_v1`; Map, Array, Vector, embedding, or irregular properties should report legacy/fallback storage and whether OLAP profiles include or ignore them.
920. Add `profile_materialization_phase_split_v1`; procedure benchmarks must split projection build, compute, result record creation, node/edge clone, sort, output serialization, and validation.
921. Add `profile_algorithm_result_sort_receipt_v1`; algorithm result ordering should record sort key, row count, memory used, stability requirement, and elapsed time.
922. Add `profile_parse_plan_overhead_receipt_v1`; Cypher-like surface claims should include parser, planner, plan-cache, executor, and materialization timings, not only storage timings.
923. Add `profile_schema_to_benchmark_framework_v1`; the product should accept schema plus query/algorithm descriptions and emit runtime plus memory-footprint benchmark reports.
924. Add `profile_algorithm_dsl_compilation_reference_v1`; GraphAlg-style DSL-to-relational/matrix compilation should remain a research lane for expressing algorithms inside graph DBs.
925. Add `profile_deterministic_semantics_guard_v1`; benchmark-compatible algorithms must record deterministic tie-breaks and original-ID mapping obligations.
926. Product principle: Rust is an enabler, not a receipt. It only becomes a product advantage when paired with lower phase-specific bytes, predictable latency, and oracle validation.
927. Product principle: a near-neighbor's honest limitations are as valuable as its wins; copy the caveat discipline into Knight Bus before copying the feature list.
928. Add `profile_complex_read_frontier_receipt_v1`; complex reads should record high-degree anchor, expansion edge type, depth range, frontier cardinalities per depth, duplicate removals, and peak frontier bytes.
929. Add `profile_cross_engine_query_receipt_v1`; same logical query across engines should record engine version, query text, parameter file hash, network/in-process mode, index/projection setup, run count, min/median/max, output row count, and correctness comparator.
930. Add `profile_scale_factor_substitution_receipt_v1`; cross-scale benchmark claims should externalize substitution params and record dataset scale factor, parameter values, parameter source file, and query family.
931. Add `profile_ldbc_interactive_harness_v1`; LDBC-SNB-inspired harnesses should separate short reads, complex reads, updates, deletes, warm-up, measured runs, errors, and cache stats.
932. Add `profile_anchor_index_build_receipt_v1`; before measuring anchored graph reads, record which labels/properties were indexed, index build time, build errors, and whether the query actually used the index.
933. Add `profile_ast_cache_receipt_v1`; Cypher-like benchmark receipts should expose parse/plan cache hits and misses because first-run latency and steady-state latency are different products.
934. Add `profile_query_result_latency_receipt_v1`; wall-clock query results should include rows, min, median, max, warm-up count, timed-run count, error text, and whether full output validation was performed.
935. Add `profile_varlength_frontier_operator_v1`; variable-length graph reads need per-depth state accounting for frontier vectors, visited sets, parent/path maps, pending output buffers, and owned adjacency lists.
936. Add `profile_frontier_dedup_strategy_v1`; dedup should declare HashSet, sorted merge, bitmap, Roaring, per-partition, spill, or approximate mode, with exactness and memory bytes.
937. Add `profile_hash_aggregate_state_receipt_v1`; aggregation after frontier expansion should record group count, key bytes, state bytes, distinct-set bytes, batch size, spill policy, and output materialization.
938. Add `profile_barrier_materialization_receipt_v1`; WITH/DISTINCT/ORDER BY/LIMIT barriers should record rows entering, rows retained, sort bytes, distinct bytes, early-limit eligibility, and truncation behavior.
939. Add `profile_special_case_detector_scope_v1`; planner optimizations should publish accept/reject reasons so unsupported shapes do not silently fall back into expensive general plans.
940. Add `profile_planner_fallback_receipt_v1`; every fallback from graph-native/profile-native path to generic execution should record the reason, chosen plan, excluded optimization, and expected cost delta.
941. Product principle: complex-read frontier profiles may be more PMF-relevant than pure PageRank because they sit exactly where users feel graph database value and pain: neighbourhood questions over connected operational data.
942. Product principle: a low-RAM graph system should sell "bounded frontier-to-aggregation receipts," not only "algorithms run with less memory."
943. Add `profile_path_materializing_varlength_v1`; path-producing variable-length reads should record relationship-container count, relationship-list bytes, stack bytes, traversal-match mode, path length distribution, downstream path/rel variable use, and close/release status.
944. Add `profile_bfs_pruning_endpoint_v1`; endpoint-only variable-length reads should record seen bytes, queue/frontier bytes, emitted endpoint count, emitted depth count, target end-node mode, and predicate acceptance/rejection counts.
945. Add `profile_depth_emission_receipt_v1`; any depth substitution for `length(path)` should record the source path expression, depth variable name, min/max depth, emitted depth range, and downstream aggregate/sort dependency.
946. Add `profile_varlength_rewrite_eligibility_v1`; planner profiles should expose horizon type, relationship/path variable liveness, min/max length, direction, expand mode, accepted optimization, rejected optimization, and typed rejection reason.
947. Add `profile_aggregation_horizon_rewrite_v1`; DISTINCT/min-length/aggregation horizons should state exactly which downstream semantics made pruning legal and which aggregate expression was rewritten or relaxed.
948. Add `profile_expand_into_policy_receipt_v1`; `ExpandInto` profiles should record whether DFS or BFS was chosen, why, worst-case warning status, sought end node, and comparator output.
949. Add `profile_trail_rewrite_guard_v1`; trail rewrites should be two-phase and reversible, recording intermediate rewrite, pruning eligibility, accepted/reverted status, and semantic guard that made the rewrite legal.
950. Add `profile_frontier_close_release_receipt_v1`; every frontier/seen/queue/path container should record allocation bytes, high-water mark, release bytes, scoped close status, and leak/failure result.
951. Add `profile_heap_tracked_collection_receipt_v1`; heap-tracked sets/maps/deques should expose capacity, resize count, backing-array bytes, release-on-resize bytes, and release-on-close bytes.
952. Add `profile_undirected_loop_frontier_receipt_v1`; undirected BFS profiles should record previous/current frontier sizes, ancestor-map bytes, loop detection state, start-node emission depth, and self-loop handling.
953. Add `profile_varlength_fixture_matrix_v1`; the first Neo4j-compatible fixture matrix should include directed/undirected, length zero, min/max depth, start-node inclusion, self-loop, shortcut, predicate, context predicate, RHS apply, `ExpandInto`, and traversal endpoint predicate cases.
954. Add `profile_predicate_context_receipt_v1`; variable-length predicates should declare whether they read current row, start node, end node, traversal endpoint, relationship cursor, or external context variable.
955. Product principle: rewrite eligibility receipts must be a sibling of RAM receipts; saving memory without proving semantic eligibility is not a trustworthy graph database product.
956. Product principle: Neo4j is not a strawman. It already has guarded plan rewrites and operator memory tracking, so Knight Bus must differentiate through budget admission, profile-specific storage, spill/stream choices, and inspectable receipts.
957. Add `profile_gds_source_reference_v1`; every GDS comparator run should record repo URL, commit, branch, local clone path, codebase-memory project, index node/edge counts, and copied-vs-inspired ideas.
958. Add `profile_gds_procedure_surface_matrix_v1`; projection and algorithm procedures should be mapped by name, mode, estimate availability, stream/stats/mutate/write surface, and expected result schema.
959. Add `profile_gds_projection_estimate_receipt_v1`; projection estimates should record native vs Cypher projection, parsed config hash, graph dimensions, read concurrency, loading estimate, and validation status.
960. Add `profile_projection_build_phase_receipt_v1`; graph materialization should separate before-loading, during-loading, after-loading, resident/mapped/heap bytes, page faults, build time, and reusable artifact ID.
961. Add `profile_algorithm_estimate_surface_v1`; algorithm estimate procedures should record graph name/config, fictitious-vs-projected graph mode, node/relationship dimensions, estimated bytes, cap, and admission decision.
962. Add `profile_pregel_state_vector_receipt_v1`; Pregel-style algorithms should record named node values, type widths, vector bytes, message buffer bytes, superstep count, convergence flag, and halt criteria.
963. Add `profile_pagerank_degree_precompute_receipt_v1`; PageRank should record degree orientation, weight-property flag, degree-vector bytes, precompute time, concurrency, and reuse/fresh-build status.
964. Add `profile_pagerank_result_extraction_receipt_v1`; PageRank output should record score-vector bytes, scaling step, write/stream/mutate mode, emitted row count, top-k checksum, and comparator delta.
965. Add `profile_bfs_state_inventory_receipt_v1`; BFS should record visited, traversedNodes, weights, minimumChunk, localNodes, chunks, resultNodes, and result-copy bytes.
966. Add `profile_chunked_frontier_order_receipt_v1`; chunked BFS should record chunk ids, synchronization order, duplicate suppression count, minimum predecessor chunk, target-found index, and depth stop reason.
967. Add `profile_local_nodes_range_receipt_v1`; per-thread local-node memory should report lower bound, upper bound, relationship upper-bound contribution, concurrency multiplier, actual high-water, and spill/recompute fallback.
968. Add `profile_disjoint_set_state_receipt_v1`; WCC should record DSS bytes, incremental flag, node count, parent/rank or equivalent arrays, union count, compression/path-shortening stats, and component checksum.
969. Add `profile_wcc_strategy_selection_receipt_v1`; WCC should record graph characteristic flags, sampled-vs-unsampled decision, partition count, threshold status, largest-component skip count, and inverse-link correctness path.
970. Add `profile_seeded_component_init_receipt_v1`; seeded WCC should record seed property, extracted initial-component bytes, missing/invalid seed count, initialization time, and comparator output delta.
971. Product principle: GDS proves estimates are table stakes; Knight Bus must convert estimates into cap admission, measured high-water receipts, profile alternatives, and fail-closed explanations.
972. Product principle: the first OLAP proof slice should compare projection estimate plus algorithm estimate plus runtime receipt, not only one `gds.<algo>.estimate` result.
973. Product principle: PageRank, BFS, and WCC each need custom state receipts before custom storage claims; otherwise lower RAM claims hide degree/message/frontier/component/output costs.
974. Add `profile_estimate_input_mode_receipt_v1`; estimate requests should record whether the graph input was a named catalog graph, store-projection map, Cypher-projection map, virtual/fictitious dimension config, or unsupported input.
975. Add `profile_graph_algorithm_composite_estimate_v1`; estimates should separate graph/projection component bytes from algorithm component bytes and then render a composite memory tree.
976. Add `profile_named_graph_catalog_estimate_v1`; named-graph estimates should record graph name, catalog lookup result, graph-store dimensions, config-derived dimensions, concurrency, and catalog artifact hash.
977. Add `profile_fictitious_graph_estimate_v1`; virtual graph estimates should record node count, relationship count, label/projection counts, highest possible node count, relationship upper bound, and overflow/large-value guard.
978. Add `profile_estimate_result_schema_parity_v1`; Neo4j/GDS-compatible estimate output should preserve `requiredMemory`, `treeView`, `mapView`, `bytesMin`, `bytesMax`, `nodeCount`, `relationshipCount`, `heapPercentageMin`, and `heapPercentageMax` or document deviations.
979. Add `profile_public_estimate_call_chain_v1`; every public estimate should map procedure annotation, parameter names, facade method, parsed config type, estimation facade, memory definition, template, and output row count.
980. Add `profile_algorithm_config_parse_receipt_v1`; parse receipts should record raw config keys, parsed config type, defaulted fields, rejected fields, concurrency, write/mutate/stream/stats mode, and typed parse errors.
981. Add `profile_uniform_estimate_envelope_v1`; PageRank/BFS/WCC and future algorithms should share an estimate-to-admission-to-run-to-receipt envelope even when their physical storage is custom.
982. Add `profile_estimate_fixture_schema_v1`; estimate tests should assert single-row guarantee, required fields, graph counts, positive or exact byte ranges, map/tree presence, and heap/cap fields.
983. Add `profile_large_virtual_graph_estimate_v1`; large synthetic dimension tests should include billion-node/billion-edge cases, byte-range exactness or bounded tolerance, integer overflow guards, and cap rejection behavior.
984. Add `profile_cap_admission_fixture_v1`; cap tests should prove admitted, rejected, slower-profile-proposed, and unsupported-exact-profile cases with typed reasons.
985. Product principle: build the first estimate API before the first heroic hot loop; the estimate API is where users learn whether the system is honest.
986. Product principle: a lower-RAM Neo4j/GDS rewrite should feel familiar at the `.estimate` surface but stricter in cap admission and richer in receipt artifacts.
987. Product principle: fictitious graph estimates are a PMF feature, not a toy. They let users ask whether a huge graph job can fit before paying projection/build cost.
988. Add `profile_memory_tree_render_schema_v1`; estimate trees should preserve human `treeView` plus a machine `mapView` with stable node names, child ordering, and numeric byte fields.
989. Add `profile_estimate_accounting_operator_v1`; every estimate node should declare whether children are summed, maxed as high-water phases, alternatives, spilled, cached, or informational.
990. Add `profile_estimate_range_arithmetic_guard_v1`; range arithmetic should reject negative bytes, reject max less than min, detect overflow, and preserve exact numeric min/max before rendering display strings.
991. Add `profile_high_water_phase_tree_v1`; runtime receipts should mirror the estimate tree with measured peak bytes per phase and a delta against admitted estimates.
992. Add `profile_machine_numeric_map_view_v1`; `mapView` should include numeric `bytesMin` and `bytesMax` per node, not only human-readable `memoryUsage` strings.
993. Product principle: low-RAM differentiation lives in the accounting operator. If phases are sequential, the right estimate is closer to max-of-phases than sum-of-everything.
994. Product principle: compatibility should preserve GDS-like tree and map views, but PMF comes from turning them into proof-carrying cap-admission and measured-high-water artifacts.
995. Add `profile_projection_memory_admission_receipt_v1`; projection/build should record estimate tree, min/max policy, cap/free bytes, graph/task reservations, admitted/rejected status, and reason before loading.
996. Add `profile_algorithm_memory_guard_receipt_v1`; algorithm runs should record algorithm label, graph dimensions, transformed dimensions, concurrency, selected estimate range, reservation result, and failure reason before execution.
997. Add `profile_task_memory_reservation_receipt_v1`; task admission should reserve bytes by username, task name, job ID, selected profile, and release status.
998. Add `profile_min_max_policy_receipt_v1`; every admission decision should say whether it used minimum estimate, maximum estimate, strict cap, percentile/empirical cap, or another named policy.
999. Add `profile_sudo_override_waiver_receipt_v1`; override paths should require an explicit waiver receipt with estimate, cap, bypassed reason, data-loss warning, and post-run high-water result.
1000. Add `profile_memory_validation_failure_receipt_v1`; failures should be typed and user-readable: insufficient cap, insufficient free memory, estimate missing, overflow, unsupported exact profile, or reservation race.
1001. Add `profile_estimation_missing_guard_receipt_v1`; missing estimates should not silently become product claims; the receipt should mark guard skipped, unsupported, or fallback-only.
1002. Add `profile_dimension_transform_admission_receipt_v1`; algorithm admission should preserve raw graph dimensions, transformed dimensions, transform reason, and byte impact.
1003. Add `profile_profile_alternative_admission_receipt_v1`; if the fastest profile fails the cap, receipts should list slower/lower-RAM alternatives with estimated bytes and latency tradeoff.
1004. Add `profile_projection_algorithm_dual_guard_v1`; projection/build and algorithm/run caps can fail independently and should be reported as separate admission stages.
1005. Add `profile_post_run_reservation_reconciliation_v1`; after completion, measured high-water, reserved bytes, released bytes, and estimate error ratio should be written back to the receipt.
1006. Product principle: GDS guards are binary enough for safety; Knight Bus should make guards router-shaped for PMF.
1007. Product principle: a budget-bounded product should propose exact lower-RAM profiles before telling the user to resize hardware or bypass validation.
1008. Product principle: `sudo`-style bypass should be treated as a signed risk artifact, not a normal success path.
1009. Add `profile_validation_policy_setting_receipt_v1`; receipts should record global validation setting, per-job override, min/max policy, cap policy, and whether the policy came from config or request.
1010. Add `profile_estimate_only_no_reservation_receipt_v1`; `.estimate` outputs should clearly state that no memory reservation was attempted and no work was admitted.
1011. Add `profile_per_job_cap_policy_v1`; users should be able to choose strict max, optimistic min, empirical percentile, or fail-closed cap policy per job.
1012. Add `profile_memory_observability_proc_v1`; memory procedures should expose user, name, entity, memory bytes, profile, cap, status, and receipt ID.
1013. Add `profile_user_memory_isolation_receipt_v1`; memory visibility should record admin/non-admin filtering and user ownership of graph/task rows.
1014. Add `profile_graph_size_detail_receipt_v1`; projected graph memory outputs should include human display, numeric size, detail map, node count, relationship count, and profile/build source.
1015. Add `profile_live_reservation_ledger_v1`; running jobs should be queryable as live ledger rows with reservation bytes, high-water bytes, spill bytes, and release status.
1016. Add `profile_completed_job_reconciliation_row_v1`; completed jobs should preserve admitted estimate, measured peak, estimate error, release timestamp, output checksum, and comparator status.
1017. Product principle: estimate-only, admission, live reservation, and completed reconciliation are different product states and should not share an ambiguous row shape.
1018. Product principle: budget-bounded compute becomes trustworthy when users can query the memory ledger while jobs are running, not only read a post-hoc benchmark table.
1019. Add `profile_graph_size_detail_map_receipt_v1`; every projected graph or storage-profile artifact should emit total, nodes, relationships, and per-relationship-type adjacency memory maps.
1020. Add `profile_node_mapping_memory_receipt_v1`; receipts should separate sparse ID structures, forward mapping, backward mapping, mapping total, and node total.
1021. Add `profile_relationship_adjacency_memory_receipt_v1`; receipts should separate degrees, offsets, target IDs, adjacency-list subtotal, and relationship total.
1022. Add `profile_adjacency_compression_histogram_receipt_v1`; receipts should expose pages, page sizes, heap/native allocations, header bits, block counts, bit-width histograms, and exception histograms where available.
1023. Add `profile_memory_measurement_unavailable_receipt_v1`; if exact object measurement is unavailable, the receipt should say so and downgrade the claim rather than pretending the detail map is complete.
1024. Add `profile_heap_offheap_split_receipt_v1`; heap, off-heap, mmap, and spill bytes should be distinct because shifting bytes outside heap is not the same as reducing total working set.
1025. Add `profile_graph_size_before_after_receipt_v1`; each run should record component memory before execution, after execution, and at high-water reconciliation.
1026. Product principle: component-level memory maps turn "lower RAM" from a slogan into an inspectable proof.
1027. Product principle: reservation bytes, estimate bytes, and actual graph component bytes are different ledgers; a credible budget-bounded product must expose all three.
1028. Add `profile_single_estimate_row_guard_v1`; every estimate procedure should have a fixture proving exactly one row and no ambiguous multi-row output.
1029. Add `profile_estimate_byte_golden_fixture_v1`; toy graphs should pin exact min/max bytes so byte arithmetic regressions are caught before algorithm work begins.
1030. Add `profile_large_virtual_graph_estimate_v1`; dimension-only estimates should include billion-scale node/relationship counts to prove overflow-safe arithmetic.
1031. Add `profile_unsupported_estimate_surface_receipt_v1`; unsupported projection/property/profile combinations should be explicit, typed, and excluded from parity claims.
1032. Add `profile_estimate_execution_path_receipt_v1`; receipts should say whether the estimate came from named graph, native projection, Cypher projection, fictitious graph, or dimension-only input.
1033. Add `profile_projection_loading_estimate_receipt_v1`; projection/build bytes should be separated from algorithm/run bytes and tied to read concurrency.
1034. Add `profile_fictitious_dimension_estimate_receipt_v1`; user-supplied node/relationship counts should carry an evidence tier and not masquerade as measured graph dimensions.
1035. Add `profile_named_graph_algorithm_only_estimate_v1`; estimates over already-projected graphs should clearly state when graph-loading bytes are absent.
1036. Add `profile_estimate_evidence_tier_v1`; every estimate should mark whether dimensions came from measured catalog graph, database scan/planner, Cypher query estimate, user-supplied virtual graph, or synthetic fixture.
1037. Product principle: the verification loop starts with executable estimates; storage engines and hot loops should be coded against those fixtures, not guessed first and justified later.
1038. Add `profile_algorithm_estimate_component_tree_v1`; every algorithm profile should expose its estimate as named components, not only total bytes.
1039. Add `profile_wcc_dss_estimate_receipt_v1`; WCC receipts should distinguish non-incremental and incremental DSS state and prove concurrency invariance where expected.
1040. Add `profile_pagerank_pregel_estimate_receipt_v1`; PageRank receipts should separate vote bits, rank value arrays, compute-step overhead, and message buffers.
1041. Add `profile_bfs_frontier_range_estimate_receipt_v1`; BFS receipts should expose frontier lower bound, upper bound, relationship cap, chunk separators, and selected bounded-frontier profile.
1042. Add `profile_estimate_concurrency_sensitivity_receipt_v1`; algorithms should declare whether concurrency changes required bytes, by which component, and by how much.
1043. Add `profile_algorithm_golden_byte_fixture_v1`; WCC, PageRank, and BFS should each have exact byte fixtures before runtime storage work is treated as done.
1044. Add `profile_large_node_count_arithmetic_fixture_v1`; billion-scale and 100B-scale dimensions should be tested to catch overflow and paging arithmetic errors.
1045. Add `profile_min_max_range_fixture_v1`; range-producing algorithms should pin min/max separately and make the chosen admission policy explicit.
1046. Add `profile_concurrency_invariant_fixture_v1`; algorithms whose estimates should not change with concurrency must prove that across low and high concurrency values.
1047. Add `profile_byte_formula_trace_receipt_v1`; every golden byte fixture should be traceable to component formulas and low-level array helpers.
1048. Add `profile_array_helper_formula_parity_v1`; custom Rust storage helpers should have their own byte-estimate tests before algorithm estimates depend on them.
1049. Product principle: component formula plus golden fixture beats vibes; a lower-RAM claim should be explainable as arithmetic before it is sold as performance.
1050. Product principle: WCC, PageRank, and BFS form the first useful estimate-family triad: concurrency-invariant per-node state, Pregel-style iterative state, and frontier-sensitive range state.
1051. Product principle: bounded-RAM mode should be expressed as a profile selected inside the estimate/admission envelope, not as an after-the-fact fallback when memory is already exhausted.
1052. Add `profile_runtime_state_owner_receipt_v1`; every significant estimate component should name the runtime object or owner that actually holds the memory.
1053. Add `profile_estimate_to_runtime_owner_diff_v1`; receipts should flag estimated components that have no measured runtime owner and runtime owners that have no estimate component.
1054. Add `profile_wcc_runtime_state_receipt_v1`; WCC should record DSS parent layout, optional seeded community layout, and sampled/unsampled strategy path.
1055. Add `profile_wcc_parent_array_profile_v1`; WCC parent state should be the first exact proof target for segmented, compressed, mmap, or checkpointed parent storage.
1056. Add `profile_pregel_runtime_state_receipt_v1`; Pregel-style algorithms should report node-value arrays, message arrays, vote bits, partitioning, and compute-step count.
1057. Add `profile_node_value_array_receipt_v1`; iterative algorithms should expose rank/value vector layout and whether it is dense RAM, mmap, delta, sparse, or phase-local.
1058. Add `profile_reducing_messenger_array_receipt_v1`; PageRank-like profiles should report send/receive buffer shape, density, and active-message policy.
1059. Add `profile_bfs_runtime_frontier_receipt_v1`; BFS should distinguish resident graph-sized arrays from variable frontier materialization.
1060. Add `profile_bfs_local_chunk_buffer_receipt_v1`; each BFS task should report local chunk buffer capacity, peak elements, reset behavior, and synchronization count.
1061. Add `profile_bfs_frontier_cap_policy_v1`; bounded BFS profiles should declare cap bytes, drain policy, spill/mmap policy, concurrency reduction, and expected latency cost.
1062. Add `profile_bfs_concurrency_latency_tradeoff_v1`; estimate receipts should show how lowering concurrency can reduce frontier high-water at the cost of more wall time.
1063. Product principle: runtime-owner alignment is what turns an estimate fixture into an implementation plan.
1064. Product principle: WCC is the cleanest first owner-state proof, PageRank is the reusable iterative-state proof, and BFS is the strongest user-facing bounded-RAM tradeoff demo.
1065. Product principle: storage innovation should attach to runtime owners, not to abstract algorithm names.
1066. Add `profile_correctness_oracle_receipt_v1`; every lower-RAM profile should name the exact oracle family, fixture graph, expected output, allowed tolerance, and evidence tier.
1067. Add `profile_wcc_component_partition_oracle_v1`; WCC correctness should compare partition equivalence, not brittle internal component id numbering alone.
1068. Add `profile_incremental_wcc_seed_oracle_v1`; seeded WCC profiles should prove merge behavior and minimum community id semantics.
1069. Add `profile_wcc_stream_schema_oracle_v1`; WCC procedure parity should prove output columns, distinct community count, filtered node set, and component equivalence.
1070. Add `profile_pagerank_numeric_tolerance_oracle_v1`; PageRank profiles should pin expected scores with explicit epsilon and explain any approximation mode separately.
1071. Add `profile_pagerank_convergence_receipt_v1`; iterative profiles should report tolerance, maximum iterations, actual iterations, convergence flag, and score drift.
1072. Add `profile_pagerank_mutate_graph_oracle_v1`; mutate/write modes should prove node properties written and graph equality or diff receipts after materialization.
1073. Add `profile_bfs_target_depth_oracle_v1`; BFS profiles should prove target break behavior, max-depth behavior, and expected mapped-node order.
1074. Add `profile_bfs_direction_loop_oracle_v1`; traversal profiles should prove incoming/outgoing direction behavior and loop termination.
1075. Add `profile_bfs_concurrency_equivalence_oracle_v1`; bounded frontier profiles should prove output equivalence across chosen concurrency/delta settings.
1076. Add `profile_oracle_estimate_runtime_triplet_v1`; the smallest credible proof unit is correctness oracle plus estimate fixture plus runtime owner receipt.
1077. Product principle: lower RAM without an oracle is only a benchmark artifact; lower RAM with oracle, cap admission, owner receipt, and high-water reconciliation is a product claim.
1078. Product principle: the first Knight Bus milestone should port one WCC triplet, one PageRank triplet, and one BFS triplet before broadening algorithm coverage.
1079. Add `profile_api_result_schema_receipt_v1`; every supported procedure mode should declare the exact row fields, value types, nullable/default behavior, and source fixture.
1080. Add `profile_requested_columns_cost_receipt_v1`; requested `YIELD` columns should be recorded and should be allowed to change post-processing work.
1081. Add `profile_optional_distribution_receipt_v1`; community and centrality distribution maps should be computed only when requested or explicitly marked skipped.
1082. Add `profile_post_processing_timing_receipt_v1`; count, histogram, path materialization, configuration serialization, and side-effect summary work should have separate timing.
1083. Add `profile_histogram_error_receipt_v1`; unsupported distribution states should return explicit error maps rather than silent blanks.
1084. Add `profile_wcc_api_result_schema_receipt_v1`; WCC stream/stats/mutate/write modes should pin `nodeId`, `componentId`, component count, component distribution, timing, side-effect, and configuration fields.
1085. Add `profile_wcc_stats_distribution_receipt_v1`; WCC distribution parity should include exact map keys and representative percentile/min/max/mean values for fixture graphs.
1086. Add `profile_centrality_stream_schema_receipt_v1`; centrality streams should prove original-node-id mapping plus `score` emission and no-value filtering.
1087. Add `profile_pagerank_api_result_schema_receipt_v1`; PageRank stats/mutate/write modes should pin convergence fields, centrality distribution, timings, side-effect millis, written count, and configuration echo.
1088. Add `profile_pagerank_iteration_field_receipt_v1`; `ranIterations` and `didConverge` should be treated as compatibility fields, not mere debug metadata.
1089. Add `profile_bfs_stream_schema_receipt_v1`; BFS stream should pin `sourceNode`, `nodeIds`, `path`, and relationship type semantics.
1090. Add `profile_bfs_path_materialization_receipt_v1`; bounded BFS profiles should declare whether path creation is eager, lazy, capped, or spill-backed.
1091. Add `profile_bfs_source_validation_receipt_v1`; invalid source/target errors should be compatibility fixtures because users automate around failure text and classes.
1092. Product principle: API parity is a separate proof layer from algorithm correctness; a correct PageRank with the wrong row schema is not a drop-in replacement.
1093. Product principle: output shape should feed the planner. If the user does not ask for a distribution or path, the lower-RAM profile should not pay for it unless required by the algorithm.
1094. Add `profile_alternative_admission_receipt_v1`; every run should list all candidate profiles, not only the selected one.
1095. Add `profile_candidate_estimate_tree_receipt_v1`; each candidate profile should expose named memory components, min/max bytes, and formula evidence.
1096. Add `profile_dimension_transform_receipt_v1`; every profile-specific dimension transform should record raw dimensions, transformed dimensions, transform reason, and byte impact.
1097. Add `profile_free_bytes_context_receipt_v1`; admission should record initial memory, graph-store reserved bytes, task reserved bytes, available bytes, requested cap, and selected required bytes.
1098. Add `profile_reservation_release_receipt_v1`; reservations should be tied to username, task name, job id, admission timestamp, release timestamp, and measured high-water.
1099. Add `profile_sudo_waiver_fixture_v1`; override paths should prove the system emitted a waiver receipt rather than silently treating bypass as ordinary success.
1100. Add `profile_candidate_accept_reject_fixture_v1`; synthetic tests should prove exact accepted/rejected alternatives under min, max, cap, and concurrency settings before hot-loop implementation starts.
1101. Add `profile_live_memory_ledger_row_v1`; running jobs should be queryable as live ledger rows with graph/task/candidate/reservation fields.
1102. Add `profile_post_run_estimate_error_receipt_v1`; every completed run should reconcile estimated bytes, reserved bytes, measured resident/high-water bytes, spill bytes, and release status.
1103. Product principle: GDS has a good binary safety guard; Knight Bus's differentiator should be a profile-admission engine that proposes lower-RAM exact alternatives before failure.
1104. Product principle: "fits under 10GB" should mean admitted against the live ledger, reserved by job id, released after completion, and reconciled against measured high-water.
1105. Product principle: the first implementation spec should port the admission-policy fixtures before porting WCC/PageRank/BFS compute loops.
1106. Add `profile_side_effect_phase_receipt_v1`; every stream/stats/mutate/write run should say whether a side effect existed, whether it ran, how long it took, and which metadata it returned.
1107. Add `profile_mutate_graph_store_residency_receipt_v1`; mutate mode should record graph-store bytes before/after, property name, node-property value layout, filtered-graph mapping, and retained resident output bytes.
1108. Add `profile_write_exporter_receipt_v1`; write mode should record exporter type, write concurrency, id-map policy, buffers, properties written, and target database/result-store path.
1109. Add `profile_result_store_side_effect_receipt_v1`; write receipts should distinguish database writeback, result-store materialization, disabled result-store behavior, and any duplicated output bytes.
1110. Add `profile_side_effect_cap_admission_v1`; profile admission should evaluate side-effect memory separately from algorithm working memory before execution starts.
1111. Add `profile_empty_result_side_effect_skip_receipt_v1`; empty graph or no-result paths should emit an explicit skip reason instead of looking like a silent successful write/mutate.
1112. Add `profile_write_progress_release_receipt_v1`; write-mode receipts should prove progress tracker creation and release, including failure/termination paths.
1113. Add `profile_mode_specific_budget_contract_v1`; the same algorithm should have separate budget contracts for stream, stats, mutate, and write.
1114. Add `profile_side_effect_result_row_receipt_v1`; result rows should tie side-effect timings and metadata to requested columns and configuration echo.
1115. Add `profile_mutated_graph_equality_receipt_v1`; mutate-mode compatibility should prove the graph-store side effect through graph equality or structured diff, not only a written-count counter.
1116. Product principle: compute fit does not imply mutate/write fit.
1117. Product principle: output mode is a planner input, not a renderer afterthought.
1118. Product principle: the most honest user promise is "this exact mode fits under this cap with this expected latency and this receipt," not "the algorithm fits."
1119. Product principle: side-effect admission is where bounded-RAM claims become operationally credible for Neo4j/GDS-compatible workflows.
1120. Add `profile_exporter_builder_binding_receipt_v1`; every write-capable profile should record exporter provider, node count, labels, id map, job id, result-store flag, write concurrency, progress tracker, and termination flag.
1121. Add `profile_write_target_mode_receipt_v1`; write mode should explicitly say native database, remote database, in-memory result store, mmap result store, SQLite result store, object-store bundle, or disabled.
1122. Add `profile_graph_write_capability_receipt_v1`; graph-store local/remote write capability should be verified before a write profile is admitted.
1123. Add `profile_native_node_property_write_receipt_v1`; native writes should record property-token resolution, value conversion, original-id mapping, non-null writes, and transaction/write API path.
1124. Add `profile_parallel_write_batch_receipt_v1`; parallel writes should record batch size, runnable count, concurrency, wait/retry policy, and cancellation settings.
1125. Add `profile_non_null_write_count_receipt_v1`; `propertiesWritten` should distinguish candidate node count from actual non-null persisted values when the target is native database writeback.
1126. Add `profile_result_store_entry_receipt_v1`; deferred result-store writes should record entry type, keys, value-vector owners, labels/types, original-id mapping, and resident bytes.
1127. Add `profile_deferred_write_artifact_receipt_v1`; result artifacts should have a durable or ephemeral location, materialization target, and downstream proof plan.
1128. Add `profile_result_store_residency_budget_v1`; deferred result stores should not be treated as free if value vectors remain resident in RAM.
1129. Add `profile_result_store_lifecycle_receipt_v1`; result-store add/get/remove/evict events, TTL, artifact path, resident/mapped bytes, and cleanup status should be queryable.
1130. Add `profile_disabled_result_store_receipt_v1`; disabled/no-op result store behavior should be explicit so a requested write target cannot silently vanish.
1131. Add `profile_exporter_fixture_parity_v1`; exporter compatibility should be tested through entry shape, written counts, persisted graph equality, progress logs, and termination behavior.
1132. Add `profile_native_writeback_graph_equality_receipt_v1`; database writeback proof should reload or inspect the target graph and compare expected properties.
1133. Add `profile_result_store_entry_shape_fixture_v1`; result-store proof should assert labels/types, keys, value vectors, original-id mapping, and job-id retrieval.
1134. Product principle: result-store writeback is a storage profile, not a mere implementation detail.
1135. Product principle: the best lower-RAM write mode is likely an externalized typed artifact with bounded resident memory, resumable materialization, and exact parity fixtures.
1136. Add `profile_relationship_exporter_builder_binding_receipt_v1`; relationship write profiles should record whether the source is graph, stream, or graph-store iterator before admission.
1137. Add `profile_relationship_write_variant_receipt_v1`; topology-only, one-property, stream, and many-property relationship outputs should be separate budget variants.
1138. Add `profile_builder_field_scope_caveat_v1`; compatibility-only or Arrow-only builder fields should be visible so they do not become accidental product semantics.
1139. Add `profile_relationship_result_store_entry_receipt_v1`; relationship result-store entries should report their exact entry class and retained graph/stream/iterator owner.
1140. Add `profile_relationship_topology_artifact_receipt_v1`; topology-only outputs should become typed edge bundles with source ids, target ids, relationship type, id-map manifest, and order policy.
1141. Add `profile_relationship_stream_artifact_receipt_v1`; stream outputs should declare whether they were fully materialized under cap or retained as a one-shot lazy stream.
1142. Add `profile_relationship_iterator_artifact_receipt_v1`; composite-iterator outputs should record property keys, node count, iterator owner, and mapped/resident bytes.
1143. Add `profile_relationship_written_count_caveat_v1`; write return values should be cross-checked against entry contents or persisted graph counts, especially where source code has a TODO.
1144. Add `profile_native_relationship_write_receipt_v1`; native relationship writes should record partition count, iterator-copy count, tokens, transactions, translated values, and progress.
1145. Add `profile_relationship_stream_buffer_receipt_v1`; buffered stream writes should record queue capacity, buffer size, flush count, final partial flush, sentinel, and high-water memory.
1146. Add `profile_composite_relationship_iterator_receipt_v1`; multi-property relationship writes should record composite iterator construction, concurrent copies, property column count, and value translation.
1147. Add `profile_relationship_write_transaction_receipt_v1`; relationship mutation phases should record transaction batch count, write API path, permission failures, and partial-write status.
1148. Add `profile_relationship_exporter_fixture_parity_v1`; compatibility tests should cover topology, scalar/array properties, duplicate edges, empty stream, buffer flush, permissions, and progress.
1149. Add `profile_relationship_topology_parity_oracle_v1`; persisted/result-store relationship topology should be compared by relationship type, source ids, target ids, and duplicate-edge policy.
1150. Add `profile_relationship_property_value_oracle_v1`; scalar, array, translated, aggregated, missing, and NaN property behavior should have explicit fixtures.
1151. Add `profile_relationship_stream_flush_oracle_v1`; streams larger than buffer size and empty streams should be first-class tests, not incidental behavior.
1152. Add `profile_result_store_materializer_presence_receipt_v1`; every deferred result-store entry type should have a named materializer and a test proving downstream materialization.
1153. Add `profile_arrow_feature_toggle_caveat_v1`; Arrow/session feature-flag evidence should be recorded separately from concrete materializer evidence.
1154. Product principle: relationship outputs are where lower-RAM OLAP becomes product-visible, because they turn abstract algorithm results into edge bundles people can inspect, ship, or write back.
1155. Add `profile_pathfinding_relationship_stream_receipt_v1`; shortest-path and Bellman-Ford writeback should record endpoints, total cost, optional path-node arrays, optional cost arrays, original-id mapping, and result target.
1156. Add `profile_path_result_array_payload_receipt_v1`; memory estimates for path outputs must count array payload bytes separately from relationship row count.
1157. Add `profile_negative_cycle_output_receipt_v1`; Bellman-Ford negative-cycle write mode should record whether output came from shortest paths or negative cycles.
1158. Add `profile_result_store_eager_collection_receipt_v1`; any output path that calls `toList()` or equivalent before deferred storage must estimate rows/bytes, enforce a cap, spill, or refuse.
1159. Add `profile_spanning_graph_relationship_receipt_v1`; spanning/Steiner outputs should record graph wrapper, expected `effectiveNodeCount - 1` edge count, property key, and parity oracle.
1160. Add `profile_kspanning_node_property_caveat_v1`; k-spanning tree should be tracked as node-property writeback even though it lives beside relationship-writing path-finding code.
1161. Add `profile_similarity_edge_score_bundle_receipt_v1`; KNN and node-similarity outputs should first target a compact `src,dst,score` bundle with id-map and distribution metadata.
1162. Add `profile_similarity_write_fixture_parity_v1`; compatibility tests should preserve one-row write-mode return, timing fields, distribution keys, relationship count, and re-projected graph equality.
1163. Add `profile_similarity_distribution_receipt_v1`; when score distributions are requested, min/max/mean/stdDev and p1/p5/p10/p25/p50/p75/p90/p95/p99/p100 fields should be pinned.
1164. Add `profile_output_carrier_selector_v1`; profile selection should use algorithm, mode, output carrier, payload shape, and target materializer, not algorithm family alone.
1165. Add `profile_output_payload_budget_v1`; every write mode should expose separate caps for row records, scalar properties, array payloads, iterator copies, and target materialization.
1166. Add `profile_topk_candidate_graph_receipt_v1`; KGE/link-prediction-like top-k outputs should record candidate graph/top-k map, model provenance, relationship count, and score property.
1167. Add `profile_ml_relationship_output_deferred_receipt_v1`; ML pipeline relationship outputs should stay out of v1 unless model/catalog/pipeline provenance and top-k candidate artifacts are testable.
1168. Product principle: the most practical first relationship-output slice is likely similarity/KNN, because it is commercially legible, graph-shaped, and simpler than path arrays.
1169. Product principle: path-finding is where bounded-RAM credibility gets tested hardest, because outputs can hide unbounded varlen arrays behind a small relationship count.
1170. Product principle: "same Neo4j surface" is not one implementation lane; each public mode maps to an output carrier family that deserves its own storage profile and parity fixture.
1171. Add `profile_wcc_component_vector_receipt_v1`; WCC should be the first integer-vector proof because component IDs, component count, component distribution, and node-properties-written are all fixture-backed.
1172. Add `profile_pagerank_score_vector_receipt_v1`; PageRank should be the first floating-vector proof because score tolerance, convergence, iterations, and centrality distribution are fixture-backed.
1173. Add `profile_bfs_node_list_path_receipt_v1`; BFS should be the first traversal-materialization proof because one output row can allocate a full node list and optional path.
1174. Add `profile_node_scalar_stream_receipt_v1`; WCC and PageRank stream modes share an internal-id scan, `hasValue` filter, original-id mapping, and scalar row output.
1175. Add `profile_node_property_target_lifecycle_receipt_v1`; stream, write, result-store, mutate, and external bundle targets must be accounted separately even when they use the same values.
1176. Add `profile_requested_output_column_cost_receipt_v1`; output columns such as BFS `path` should be planner inputs because they change post-processing memory and latency.
1177. Add `profile_write_mode_capability_guard_v1`; write receipts should record graph-store write mode, property state, result-store/Arrow requirement, and failure reason before export.
1178. Add `profile_mutate_residency_delta_receipt_v1`; mutate mode should record graph-store memory before/after and filtered-graph remap state because it keeps output resident for later algorithms.
1179. Add `profile_algorithm_label_identity_caveat_v1`; progress/procedure labels should not be the only identity proof because source-level label arguments can differ from public algorithm names.
1180. Add `profile_starter_slice_fixture_matrix_v1`; WCC/PageRank/BFS should have a single matrix mapping public procedure, mode, carrier, target, fixture oracle, timing fields, and memory receipt.
1181. Product principle: WCC is the lowest-risk first correctness slice; PageRank is the first famous numeric slice; BFS is the first output-materialization budget slice.
1182. Product principle: the first storage innovation can be boring and still powerful: a proof-carrying node-property vector bundle with explicit target lifecycle beats a hand-wavy database rewrite.
1183. Product principle: after WCC/PageRank/BFS prove vector and traversal carriers, KNN/similarity is the cleanest next jump into relationship output.
1184. Product principle: requested result columns are part of the storage plan, not presentation sugar, because they can force arrays, boxing, lists, path objects, histograms, or distributions.
1185. Add `profile_similarity_graph_build_receipt_v1`; similarity graph construction should record source stream, root-id mapping, relationship/property keys, direction, compared nodes, edge count, build bytes, and top-k/full-graph flag.
1186. Add `profile_similarity_pair_count_admission_v1`; KNN/node-similarity planning should estimate max pairs, topN cap, topK degree cap, cutoff impact, expected edge count, and cap/refuse/spill behavior before materialization.
1187. Add `profile_knn_edge_score_bundle_receipt_v1`; KNN should externalize the first relationship-output proof as `src,dst,score` columns plus id-map, convergence, iteration, and pair-count sidecars.
1188. Add `profile_similarity_filter_lifecycle_receipt_v1`; filtered KNN should record whether rows came from target filtering or KNN result streaming, which producer was retained, and where unused state was released.
1189. Add `profile_similarity_mode_cost_matrix_v1`; stream, stats, write, mutate, exact-distribution, approximate-distribution, and no-distribution variants should publish different memory and latency expectations.
1190. Add `profile_similarity_distribution_oracle_v1`; min, max, mean, stdDev, p1, p5, p10, p25, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99, and p100 should be treated as fixture-pinned output when distribution is requested.
1191. Add `profile_similarity_producer_path_receipt_v1`; KNN result streams, filtered KNN streams, and node-similarity graph results should share the same bundle target while recording their producer path.
1192. Add `profile_similarity_fixture_matrix_v1`; KNN, filtered KNN, node similarity, and filtered node similarity should pin stream rows, stats counters, write/mutate one-row contracts, graph equality, and score tolerance.
1193. Product principle: KNN/similarity is the first relationship-output slice because it is graph-shaped and commercially legible while avoiding path-array payload complexity.
1194. Product principle: exact distribution is an optional cost center, not a default inevitability; users should be able to trade distribution fidelity for a tighter RAM cap.
1195. Product principle: "GDS-compatible" and "budget-bounded" should be two explicit modes for similarity, with receipts explaining whether we built a similarity graph or wrote a capped edge-score bundle.
1196. Product principle: if similarity proves bundle-first writeback, path-finding can inherit the receipt pattern but will need a separate varlen path-array budget model.
1197. Add `profile_path_result_varlen_carrier_receipt_v1`; path outputs should record per-path node/cost/relationship-id lengths, array ownership, clone policy, source/target ids, and total-cost derivation.
1198. Add `profile_path_stream_materialization_receipt_v1`; stream mode should record internal-to-original id rewrite count, boxed `List<Long>` and `List<Double>` creation, path object creation, and close/consumption status.
1199. Add `profile_path_requested_column_budget_v1`; path-family memory admission should treat `nodeIds`, `costs`, `path`, and route/negative-cycle columns as requested payloads with separate byte costs.
1200. Add `profile_path_write_payload_option_receipt_v1`; write mode should record `writeNodeIds`, `writeCosts`, property key/type list, missing/null property behavior, and per-relationship payload bytes.
1201. Add `profile_path_result_store_eager_spool_receipt_v1`; result-store path writes should never call eager collection without row-count estimate, payload estimate, cap, spill location, or refusal reason.
1202. Add `profile_path_family_subtype_selector_v1`; path planning should choose distance-row, endpoint-cost, route-array, random-walk, virtual-path, or negative-cycle subtype before selecting storage.
1203. Add `profile_path_negative_cycle_receipt_v1`; Bellman-Ford should record whether output came from shortest paths or negative cycles, and whether write/mutate negative-cycle flags allowed materialization.
1204. Add `profile_path_fixture_matrix_v1`; all-shortest-path, Dijkstra, A*, Yen's, Bellman-Ford, and random-walk fixtures should pin rows, route arrays, flag-null behavior, path objects, total costs, and relationship counts.
1205. Product principle: path-finding is not the first relationship-output implementation slice, but it is the first hard-RAM credibility slice because output payload can dominate compute state.
1206. Product principle: endpoint-cost-only graph output and full route persistence should be different SKU-level modes, because they have very different RAM and latency profiles.
1207. Product principle: result-store/deferred-output design needs a spill-first story before path outputs, because GDS source evidence shows deferred streams can force eager collection.
1208. Product principle: all-pairs/distance-table rows and route/path rows must not share one storage format; a fixed distance table can be compact, while route arrays need varlen sidecars and offsets.
1209. Product principle: Neo4j-compatible path objects should be treated as materializers over a compact route bundle, not as the default durable storage representation.
1210. Add `profile_node_embedding_matrix_receipt_v1`; embedding algorithms should report node count, dimension, value type, matrix owner, original-id map, property name, target mode, and resident/mapped bytes.
1211. Add `profile_embedding_value_type_receipt_v1`; f32, f64, and binary-bitset embeddings should be separate storage variants with explicit dense materialization policies.
1212. Add `profile_binary_embedding_materializer_receipt_v1`; bitset-backed embeddings should record bitset bytes, dense output type, set-bit count, conversion bytes, and materialization latency.
1213. Add `profile_embedding_stream_materialization_receipt_v1`; stream mode should record original-id mapping, `hasValue` filtering, boxed-list allocation, row/page size, selected columns, and stream high-water.
1214. Add `profile_embedding_stream_write_mutate_parity_v1`; embedding rows, node-property writes, graph-store mutation, result-store targets, timings, and property equality should be verified together.
1215. Add `profile_embedding_loss_sidecar_receipt_v1`; Node2Vec-like loss histories should be modeled as sidecars so they do not pollute the matrix artifact budget.
1216. Add `profile_embedding_algorithm_label_caveat_v1`; source-level progress/procedure labels should be recorded but not treated as algorithm identity proof without fixtures.
1217. Add `profile_ml_topk_relationship_receipt_v1`; ML top-k outputs should record candidate sets, topK cap, embedding property, relationship-type embedding, score function, and queue bytes before materialization.
1218. Add `profile_kge_stream_fixture_oracle_v1`; KGE stream parity should pin source/target filters, topK, score function, expected rows, score tolerance, and original-id mapping.
1219. Add `profile_kge_write_target_receipt_v1`; KGE write mode should record `TopKGraph` relationship count, relationship type, score property, exporter/result-store target, job id, and write timings.
1220. Add `profile_kge_mutate_graph_store_receipt_v1`; KGE mutate mode should record relationship-builder orientation, aggregation, graph-store relationship type, property key, concurrency, and graph equality.
1221. Add `profile_model_provenance_sidecar_receipt_v1`; pipeline-backed ML predictions should record model name, username, catalog id, train config hash, pipeline hash, classifier type, graph-store filter, and dependency context.
1222. Product principle: embeddings are matrix-shaped outputs, not scalar node properties; store the typed matrix and materialize Neo4j-compatible lists only at the API boundary.
1223. Product principle: binary embeddings are a strong pattern match for Knight Bus because compact internal storage and dense public materialization are already separated in GDS.
1224. Product principle: embedding matrices should come after WCC/PageRank scalar vectors and before path-route bundles in the implementation spine.
1225. Product principle: KGE can share an edge-score bundle with KNN only if candidate-set and scorer provenance are receipt-visible.
1226. Product principle: full link-prediction pipelines should stay later than KGE because model catalog, trained pipeline, graph-store filters, classifier factory, and execution context expand the parity surface.
1227. Product principle: row-level API compatibility and artifact-level RAM proof are different receipts; one-row write/mutate summaries are not enough to prove bounded memory.
1228. Add `profile_fastrp_three_matrix_estimate_receipt_v1`; FastRP caps should count output embeddings, A/B work embeddings, property vectors, fixture expectation, and measured peak separately.
1229. Add `profile_node2vec_walk_model_estimate_receipt_v1`; Node2Vec caps should expose random-walk storage, probability-cache storage, center/context model matrices, and loss-sidecar bytes.
1230. Add `profile_graphsage_resident_temporary_split_receipt_v1`; GraphSAGE mode should determine whether result features are resident or temporary.
1231. Add `profile_graphsage_training_batch_estimate_receipt_v1`; GraphSAGE training needs its own profile because weights, optimizer state, fanout-expanded batches, and backward-pass buffers do not exist in plain inference.
1232. Add `profile_graphsage_aggregator_cost_selector_v1`; aggregator type should be a visible RAM/latency knob, especially mean versus pool aggregation.
1233. Add `profile_hashgnn_sparse_dense_range_receipt_v1`; HashGNN is the source-backed precedent for compact internal bitsets plus dense public materialization range.
1234. Add `profile_kge_candidate_topk_estimate_receipt_v1`; KGE should expose source/target bitsets, candidate-pair upper bound, scorer/model inputs, topK queues, and materializer bytes.
1235. Add `profile_embedding_estimate_fixture_matrix_v1`; every ported GDS embedding estimate should preserve source fixture path, config, expected bytes, our estimated bytes, measured peak, and delta.
1236. Add `profile_topk_estimate_wiring_caveat_v1`; reused top-k estimates need source-path evidence and an explicit caveat when an algorithm-specific estimator is not found.
1237. Product principle: "predictable output bytes" is not the same as "predictable peak RAM"; the receipt must split durable output, scratch state, training state, API materialization, and side-effect target.
1238. Product principle: embedding algorithms are a family of storage profiles, not one embedding profile; FastRP, Node2Vec, GraphSAGE inference, GraphSAGE training, and HashGNN each need separate admission math.
1239. Product principle: matrix storage can still be a strong early lane, but only after boxed stream rows and dense public materializers become bounded materialization phases.
1240. Product principle: GNN training should remain after the first OLAP wedge unless the product deliberately chooses a training-cost-reduction wedge.
1241. Product principle: KGE is a later ML top-k proof, not the first edge-score proof; prove KNN/node-similarity first, then add KGE scorer/candidate receipts.
1242. Product principle: a public RAM-saving claim should include both an estimate fixture and a measured high-water mark; otherwise the system is merely promising, not proving.
1243. Add `profile_wcc_dss_estimate_receipt_v1`; WCC should be the first exact memory-estimate port because its DSS component is simple, fixture-pinned, and concurrency-invariant in the tested cases.
1244. Add `profile_public_estimate_row_receipt_v1`; estimate endpoints should return structured rows with requiredMemory, tree/map views, bytesMin/bytesMax, graph dimensions, heap percentages, selected profile, and cap decision.

1288. Product principle: KNN is the first tiny edge-score fixture; Node Similarity is the first full relationship-output fixture matrix.

1330. Add `profile_wcc_strategy_selector_receipt_v1`; WCC strategy choice is a correctness surface, not an optimization footnote.
